subject: 🐋 Thank you, truly
preview: You just helped a small team keep building. Here's how to get the most from Premium.
h1_bold: You're now a MindSync Premium member.

blocks.alt: Illustration: an orca tail rising over waves in front of a coral sun

blocks.text: We're a small team, and every subscription keeps the lights on and the orca swimming. Seriously, thank you.
Three habits that make Premium worth it

items: Open your After therapy card right after each session, while it's still fresh.
Check your Before therapy card the evening before your next one.
Rate your Focus Areas once a week. After three sessions, the After therapy card starts showing Your progress in therapy.

blocks.alt: Three MindSync screens: the Before therapy card with numbered questions, the After therapy card with the progress chart, and Timeline

blocks.text: Something not working the way you expected? Hit reply and tell me. That goes for billing too.

footer_promise: We promise to only send you mental health-related tips & updates.
